## Plan board: "Auto-advance transparency"

**Root cause found:** auto-advance's ON state is client-local and transient — `automating` in `src/app/features/task.jsx:50` resets on every task switch (`task.jsx:75`) and on remount, while the server registry (`ACTIVE_RUNS`, `server/bridza-run.js:428`) only tracks the *current stage*, never the chain. So after navigating away/back the toggle lies (off while the chain keeps running), the "which stage" info is hidden, and the toggle can even start a *second* chain.

**4 subtasks** (milestone `ms-auto-advance-transparency`, critical path 10h):

| Task | Est | Deps (all) |
|---|---|---|
| `auto-advance-chain-registry` — server tracks chains (pipeline/task, stage, index/count, phase) in state payload; `/stop` kills the whole chain | 5h | — |
| `auto-advance-state-truth-toggle` — switch + run-log card derive from server truth: "⚡ Auto-advancing · 2/5 · Design" survives revisit/other windows; double-start blocked | 5h | chain-registry |
| `auto-advance-progress-badges` — "⚡ 3/5 · Build" chips on board & plan cards, manual runs excluded | 3h | chain-registry |
| `auto-advance-stop-and-resume` — stopped-at banner (stage, reason) + exact resume; no silent restart while chain active | 4h | chain-registry |

Verdices are parallel on top of the registry. `when-opening-a-task-or-card-it-should` (auto-start policy) overlaps the open-time auto-restart path only at the touch points flagged in `auto-advance-state-truth-toggle`'s acceptance — left parallel, not gated.
